## The Carolina Paws Legacy

Since April 1, 2009, Carolina Paws Dog Grooming LLC has been Columbia's premier destination for exceptional dog grooming services. Our foundation is built on quality grooming combined with sincere caring for the well-being of each and every dog.

We understand that grooming can be a stressful experience for many dogs. That's why we've dedicated ourselves to creating an environment where extra attention eliminates stress, allowing every dog to feel relaxed and comfortable throughout their visit.

Our mission is simple yet profound: to provide a team that genuinely cares for your dogs, making each one feel as comfortable as being at home. Every grooming appointment becomes a special day at Carolina Paws.

#### Meet Kimberly Power, Founder & Owner

"My lifelong love for dogs led me to fulfill my dream of creating Carolina Paws. What started as a vision has become a reality where customers have found that special place they were searching for - a place where their beloved companions receive the personalized, caring attention they deserve."

## Trusted Pet Care in New York City

At New York Dog Spa & Hotel, we provide a safe, comfortable environment where pets can relax, play, and feel loved — right in the heart of Manhattan. Our team of experienced pet care professionals treats every guest like family, offering personalized attention, luxurious spa services, and enriching playtime designed to keep tails wagging.

And because your pet’s comfort and safety come first, our dedicated staff is on-site 24/7 — so your dog is never left alone, day or night.

![Ruff housing Cary Location](https://images.destpet.com/is/image/destpet/203NYO-favicon-57?ts=1760304269420&dpr=off)

## Dog Spa & Hotel - 20th Street

Nestled near Gramercy Park, our 20th Street Dog Spa & Hotel offers an intimate, boutique-style atmosphere that’s perfect for pets who prefer a quieter, personalized experience. Whether your pup visits for grooming, daycare, or an overnight stay, our compassionate team ensures every moment is calm, comforting, and filled with care.

**Staff members are on-site around the clock to provide continuous supervision and comfort — even after business hours.**

[Visit Dog Spa & Hotel - 20th Street](https://www.nydog20th.com/)

![Ruff housing Country club Location](https://images.destpet.com/is/image/destpet/203NYO-favicon-57?ts=1760304272427&dpr=off)

## Dog Spa & Hotel - 25th Street

Located in the lively Kips Bay neighborhood, our 25th Street location is a vibrant, social space designed for dogs who love to play and make new friends. Featuring spacious daycare areas, expert training programs, cozy boarding suites, and professional grooming services, this location provides a full-service experience for every type of pup.

**With staff present 24/7, every guest enjoys safe, attentive care no matter the hour.**

[Visit Dog Spa & Hotel - 25th Street](https://www.nydog25th.com/)

## Because Comfort Never Clocks Out

No matter which location you choose, your pet will receive exceptional care from the same trusted Dog Spa & Hotel team. Both of our Manhattan locations provide premium grooming, daycare, boarding, and enrichment — supported by **dedicated caregivers who are always on-site** to ensure your dog feels secure, loved, and right at home.
